items.original: 你曾为了改变体重或体形而试图刻意限制自己的进食量？（无论你是否已经成功）
items.translation: Have you ever tried to deliberately restrict how much you eat in order to change your weight or shape? (whether or not you succeeded)

items.original: 你曾为了改变体重或体形在很长一段时间内（清醒状态下8小时或更长）不进食？
items.translation: Have you ever gone without eating for a long period of time (8 or more hours while awake) in order to change your weight or shape?

items.original: 你曾因思考食物、进食、或卡路里而难以将注意力集中于自己感兴趣的事情上（例如工作、交谈、或者读书）？
items.translation: Have you ever found it hard to concentrate on things you are interested in (e.g., work, conversations, or reading) because you were thinking about food, eating, or calories?

items.original: 你曾因思考体重或体形而难以将注意力集中于自己感兴趣的事情上（例如工作、交谈、或者读书）？
items.translation: Have you ever found it hard to concentrate on things you are interested in (e.g., work, conversations, or reading) because you were thinking about your weight or shape?

items.original: 你曾明确地惧怕自己可能会变胖？
items.translation: Have you ever had a definite fear of gaining weight?

items.original: 你曾对减肥有强烈的渴望？
items.translation: Have you ever had a strong desire to lose weight?

items.original: 你曾试图让自己呕吐或服用泻药来控制自己的体重或体形？
items.translation: Have you ever tried to make yourself vomit or taken laxatives to control your weight or shape?

items.original: 你曾以“驱使”或“强迫”自己运动的方式来控制自己的体重、体形、体脂含量或燃烧卡路里？
items.translation: Have you ever exercised in a driven or compelled way to control your weight, shape, body fat, or to burn calories?

items.original: 当你在进食的时候，你曾产生对进食失去控制的感觉？
items.translation: When you were eating, have you ever felt that you had lost control over your eating?

items.original: 在你对进食失去控制的时间里，其中有多少天你一次性吃了他人会认为量特别大的食物？
items.translation: During the times when you felt out of control with eating, on how many days did you, in a single sitting, eat an amount of food that others would consider especially large?

items.original: 你的体重或体形影响了你对自己作为一个人的想法或评价吗？
items.translation: Does your weight or shape influence how you think about or judge yourself as a person?

items.original: 你对自己的体重或体形有多不满意？
items.translation: How dissatisfied are you with your weight or shape?
